cases.title: Click Available Seat to Select and Update Count
cases.description: Verify that clicking an available seat marks it as selected and updates the selected seat count in the element with data-testid="selected-count".

cases.title: Select Movie from Dropdown and Calculate Total Price
cases.description: Verify that selecting a movie from the dropdown with data-testid="movie-select" updates the ticket price and calculates the total price in data-testid="total-price" as the number of selected seats multiplied by the movie price.

cases.title: Prevent Selection of Occupied Seats
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as occupied cannot be selected and do not affect the seat count or total price.

cases.title: Update Total Price on Movie Change
cases.description: Verify that changing the selected movie at any time dynamically updates the total price accordingly based on the current number of selected seats.

cases.title: Select movie from dropdown and update ticket price
cases.description: Verify that a user can select a movie from the dropdown menu (e.g., 'The Big Lebowski ($10)', 'Fargo ($12)', 'O Brother ($8)', 'No Country for Old Men ($9)', each identified by a specific data-testid) and its price updates accordingly.

cases.title: Toggle available seat selection and store in localStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking on an available seat (e.g., identified by data-testid="seat-1-1") toggles the seat's selection status, visually marks the seat as selected, and stores its index in localStorage.

cases.title: Dynamically update seat count and total price
cases.description: Verify that the seat count (data-testid="selected-count") and total price (data-testid="total-price") dynamically update based on the number of selected seats and the chosen movie's price.

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as 'occupied' cannot be selected or included in the calculation.

cases.title: Deselect previously selected seats
cases.description: Verify that users can deselect previously selected seats by clicking on them again, and the UI, along with localStorage, updates accordingly.

cases.title: Restore selected seats and movie selection from local storage on load
cases.description: Verify that when local storage contains 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', the system retrieves them on page load, marks the corresponding seats with the 'selected' class, and sets the movie dropdown to the correct option.

cases.title: Default state when local storage is empty
cases.description: Verify that when local storage does not contain 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex' keys, no seats are marked as 'selected' and the movie dropdown defaults to the first movie option, 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Select available seat updates count and total price
cases.description: Verify that clicking on an available seat toggles the 'selected' class, updates the selected seat count in 'selected-count', and calculates the total price in 'total-price' as the product of selected seats and ticket price.

cases.title: Deselect previously selected seat decreases count and total price
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a selected seat again deselects it, decreasing the selected seat count and total price accordingly.

cases.title: Select movie from dropdown updates ticket price and total price
cases.description: Verify that selecting a movie from 'movie-select' sets the ticket price and dynamically updates the total price based on the current number of selected seats.

cases.title: Change movie selection maintains seat count and updates total price
cases.description: Verify that changing the movie selection after seats have been chosen updates the total price using the new ticket price while maintaining the existing count of selected seats.

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that the system prevents users from selecting seats marked with the 'occupied' class.

cases.title: Verify seat status legends and interactions
cases.description: Verify that users can distinguish between available, selected, and occupied seats through legends (such as data-testid='seat-select'), where occupied seats are non-interactive, available seats can be clicked to toggle their selection, and seat counts and total prices update accordingly upon selection or deselection.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and corresponding test cases are fully aligned, clear, and cover all specified paths and scenarios without blockers or coverage gaps.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1 contains multiple distinct behaviors: interacting with the seat map to update total price, clicking available seats to mark as selected and update selected seat count in data-testid="selected-count", selecting a movie from data-testid="movie-select" with value representing ticket price, calculating total price in data-testid="total-price" as selected seats multiplied by movie price, preventing selection of occupied seats, and updating total price when changing the selected movie. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2 contains multiple behaviors: selecting a movie from dropdown with specific options, updating price on movie selection, toggling seat selection status on click, visually marking selected seats, storing indices in localStorage, dynamically updating seat count and total price, preventing selection of occupied seats, and deselecting seats by clicking again with updates to UI and localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3 contains multiple behaviors: retrieving and applying previously selected seats and movie selection from localStorage on load, marking seats corresponding to 'selectedSeats' with 'selected' class, setting movie dropdown to 'selectedMovieIndex', handling absence of values by defaulting seats to none selected and dropdown to the first movie option. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4 contains multiple behaviors: dynamically displaying seat count and total price, setting ticket price on movie selection, toggling 'selected' class on available seat clicks, updating count in data-testid 'selected-count', calculating total price in data-testid 'total-price', decreasing count and price on seat deselection, updating total price on movie change while maintaining count, and preventing selection of occupied seats. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5 contains multiple behaviors: displaying legends with data-testid = 'seat-select' for status, non-interactive occupied seats, clicking available seats to toggle selection, and updating count and total price on selection or deselection.
